events.sql: SELECT fact_id, value, unit, plain, kind, valid_from, valid_to, source_url, checked_on FROM retrofit_pg.price_fact
events.purpose: Dated prices and costs for rough money

events.sql: SELECT scheme_id, measure, amount_gbp, plain, condition, valid_from, valid_to, source_url, checked_on FROM retrofit_pg.grant_scheme
SELECT facing, azimuth_deg, pitch_deg, area_m2 FROM retrofit_pg.roof_plane WHERE house_id = 'osm-way-1556408737' ORDER BY area_m2 DESC
SELECT wall_no, facing_deg, length_m, fronts_highway, highway_name, distance_m, adjoins FROM retrofit_pg.house_wall WHERE house_id = 'osm-way-1556408737' ORDER BY wall_no
SELECT noise_pct, flat_pct, eaves_m, ridge_m, method FROM retrofit_pg.roof_survey WHERE house_id = 'osm-way-1556408737'
events.purpose: How clean the LIDAR roof reading is

events.sql: SELECT rule_id, measure, clause, plain, applies_when, effect, in_force, amended_by, source_url, checked_on FROM retrofit_pg.pd_rule
SELECT house_id, label, lat, lon, building, footprint_m2, source FROM retrofit_pg.house WHERE house_id = 'osm-way-1556408737'
SELECT facing, kwp, kwh_year, params, source FROM retrofit_pg.pv_estimate WHERE house_id = 'osm-way-1556408737'

SELECT d.dataset, d.reference, d.name, d.grade, d.start_date, d.end_date, d.entity, d.organisation,
       a.removes_solar, a.removes_ashp, a.removes_walls, a.summary AS a4_summary, a.source_url AS a4_source, a.end_date AS a4_end_date
FROM retrofit_pg.designation d
LEFT JOIN retrofit_pg.article4_rule a ON a.reference = d.reference
WHERE d.house_id = 'osm-way-1556408737'
